package.name: visual_sonar_ros
package.description:
Visual Sonar ROS - Advanced mobile robot navigation system using omnidirectional vision.
This package implements a sophisticated Visual Sonar algorithm that simulates sonar-like obstacle detection using computer vision techniques. It processes omnidirectional camera images to detect obstacles and compute safe navigation paths for autonomous mobile robots.
Key Features: - Multiple edge detection algorithms (Sobel, Canny, Laplacian, Scharr, Roberts, Prewitt) - Advanced light reflection elimination - Configurable virtual sonar beam processing - Graduated speed control based on obstacle proximity - Real-time visualization and diagnostics - Parameter server integration for runtime configuration - Safety mechanisms with emergency stop capability
The system has been tested on various robotic platforms and published in multiple IEEE conferences focusing on mobile robot navigation and omnidirectional vision.
package.author: Mohammad Hossein Bamorovat Abadi

export.keywords: visual-sonar, mobile-robot, navigation, omnidirectional-vision, obstacle-avoidance, computer-vision, edge-detection, autonomous-navigation
